headlines.title_en: Wang Yi: Appreciates Indonesia's reaffirmation of welcoming Chinese enterprises to invest and cooperate in Indonesia
headlines.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs website, on July 18, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, met in Shanghai with Airlangga Hartarto, Indonesia's Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs, who was attending the World Artificial Intelligence Conference. Wang Yi emphasized that under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state, positive progress has been made in building a China-Indonesia community with a shared future in recent years. As representatives of the Global South and emerging economies, China and Indonesia share similar development goals, broad common interests, and obvious complementary advantages. Both sides should strengthen the alignment of development strategies, move in the same direction, interact positively, eliminate interference, maintain focus, continuously deepen mutually beneficial cooperation in various fields, and serve as a model for the Global South in unity, mutual assistance, and joint self-reliance. China appreciates the Coordinating Minister's reaffirmation of welcoming Chinese enterprises to invest and cooperate in Indonesia and hopes Indonesia will provide a fair and equitable business environment. China-Indonesia cooperation is not targeted at any third party and should not be interfered with by any third party. Both sides should take the lead in defending the multilateral trading system.

headlines.title: China’s second-quarter GDP growth misses mark, with lowest reading since end of 2022
headlines.summary:
China reported 4.3 per cent gross domestic product growth in the second quarter of 2026 shortly after recording strong, sustained momentum in exports – a contrast underscoring the need for policy support to address weak domestic demand and persistent economic imbalances.
The closely watched GDP figure, released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday, was the slowest quarterly growth rate since the end of 2022. The number fell below the 4.48 per cent forecast from economists...

headlines.title: 太空计算服务专委会正式成立
headlines.summary: 7月18日，在2026世界人工智能大会（WAIC）期间，由工业和信息化部中小企业发展促进中心发起的中国中小企业国际合作协会太空计算服务专业委员会正式成立。作为国内首个聚焦太空计算、面向广大中小企业服务的全国性产业协同平台，专委会将搭建一体化产业对接载体，助力中小企业贯通星地算力全产业链条，助推我国空天信息产业高质量发展。东方天算作为专委会常务理事单位，联合四十余家产业链上下游主体，共同构建产学研用深度融合的产业枢纽。（界面）(金十数据APP)

headlines.title_en: Space Computing Services Special Committee officially established
headlines.summary_en: On July 18, during the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC), the Space Computing Service Professional Committee of the China International Cooperation Association of Small and Medium Enterprises, initiated by the SME Development Promotion Center of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, was officially established. As the first national industrial collaboration platform focused on space computing and serving small and medium-sized enterprises, the committee will build an integrated industry-academia-research-application hub to help SMEs connect the entire satellite-ground computing power industry chain, boosting the high-quality development of China's aerospace information industry. Oriental TianSuan, as a standing council member unit of the committee, joined over 40 upstream and downstream industry chain entities to co-build an industry hub for deep integration of industry, academia, research, and application. (Jiemian) (Jin10 Data APP)

headlines.title: 中国首创AI赋能核能技术路线全球首发
headlines.summary: 记者18日从中国科学院近代物理研究所获悉，在2026世界人工智能大会暨人工智能全球治理高级别会议期间，中国首创的人工智能赋能加速器驱动先进核能系统(AI for ADANES)技术路线面向全球首发，其全域创新联盟同步揭牌成立。据介绍，该技术路线通过搭建物理本征世界模型智能体系，首创“数据+物理模型+专家经验三重驱动”全新范式，破解了AI“黑箱不可控”与核工业“安全零容错”的核心矛盾，填补了全球先进核能智能化落地的技术空白。（中新网）

headlines.title_en: China's first AI-empowered nuclear technology roadmap debuts globally
headlines.summary_en: Reporters learned from the Institute of Modern Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences on the 18th that during the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance, a pioneering Chinese technology route — AI-empowered Accelerator-Driven Advanced Nuclear Energy System (AI for ADANES) — was unveiled globally, with its global innovation alliance inaugurated. According to the introduction, this technology route, by building an intelligent system of a physical intrinsic world model, pioneers a new paradigm driven by 'data + physical models + expert experience,' resolving the core contradiction between 'uncontrollable black-box' AI and the 'zero-error tolerance' nuclear industry, filling a global technology gap in the intelligent deployment of advanced nuclear energy. (China News Service)

headlines.title: 本周超2100亿元资金借道ETF进场扫货 科创芯片、通信等板块正被疯狂抄底
headlines.summary: 据每经，本周股指大幅回调，但资金蜂拥进场抄底，沪深两市股票型ETF和跨境型ETF合计净流入2113.21亿元。细分来看，主要宽基指数整体资金申赎统计显示，本周沪深300净流入400亿元。 在行业主题ETF方面，本周净流入资金超1亿元的基金有78只，其中科创芯片ETF嘉实、通信ETF国泰、半导体设备ETF易方达份额分别增加了10.65亿份、49.94亿份和18.18亿份，净流入资金42.04亿元、32.76亿元和23.35亿元。有券商表示，随着AIGC等人工智能技术发展，算力需求持续爆发，推动通信网络向高速率、大带宽、低时延方向演进，光通信、高速连接器等细

headlines.title_en: Over 210 billion yuan in funds entered via ETFs this week, with sectors like ChipSciTech and Communications seeing aggressive bottom-fishing
headlines.summary_en: According to National Business Daily, major indices corrected this week, but funds rushed in to buy the dip. Total net inflows into Shanghai and Shenzhen stock ETFs and cross-border ETFs reached 211.321 billion yuan. Sub-divided, statistics on overall subscriptions and redemptions of main broad-based indices showed a net inflow of 40 billion yuan into the CSI 300 this week. In industry thematic ETFs, 78 funds saw net inflows exceeding 100 million yuan this week. Among them, the shares of Harvest SSE STAR Chip ETF, Guotai Communication ETF, and Yinhua Semiconductor Equipment ETF increased by 1.065 billion, 4.994 billion, and 1.818 billion units respectively, with net fund inflows of 4.204 billion yuan, 3.276 billion yuan, and 2.335 billion yuan. A securities firm noted that with the development of AIGC and other AI technologies, computing power demand continues to surge, driving communication networks towards high speed, large bandwidth, and low latency, with optical communication and high-speed connectors as key areas...

headlines.title: 印尼投资部部长：对中印尼投资合作未来充满信心
headlines.summary: 印度尼西亚投资与下游化部部长罗山表示，印尼政府将继续推行促进贸易投资、改善营商环境的政策，对中国和印尼投资合作的未来充满信心。 罗山说，印尼始终保持开放态度，致力于维护稳定、透明和友好的投资环境。近期政策调整的目标是加强产业治理、提升竞争力，并为印尼经济创造更大的长期价值，不会阻碍外国投资，更不是为了针对任何特定国家或投资伙伴。

headlines.title_en: Indonesian Minister of Investment: Full of confidence in the future of China-Indonesia investment cooperation
headlines.summary_en: Indonesia's Minister of Investment and Downstreaming, Rosan Roeslani, stated that the Indonesian government will continue policies to promote trade, investment, and improve the business environment, expressing full confidence in the future of China-Indonesia investment cooperation. Rosan said Indonesia remains open, committed to maintaining a stable, transparent, and friendly investment environment. Recent policy adjustments aim to strengthen industrial governance, enhance competitiveness, and create greater long-term value for Indonesia's economy, and will not hinder foreign investment, nor are they targeted at any specific country or investment partner.

headlines.title: Tianjin 1H foreign trade hits 405.9 bln yuan
headlines.summary: Tianjin customs reports 1H foreign trade totaled 405.9 bln yuan, up 2.4% YoY; exports were 226.6 bln yuan, up 9.2% YoY. Both total trade and exports were record highs for the period.
headlines.title_zh: 天津上半年外贸进出口额达4059亿元
headlines.summary_zh: 天津海关报告，上半年外贸总额4059亿元，同比增长2.4%；出口2266亿元，同比增长9.2%。外贸总额与出口均创同期历史新高。
